            </div>

            <!-- Personalized Learning Pathway Selector -->
            <div id="pathways-selector-card" class="p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1b2b3a] to-[#172126] text-white shadow-2xl border border-stone-700 space-y-6">
              <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-stone-700/80 pb-4">
                <div>
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#edae9d] animate-pulse"></span>
                    <span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold text-[#edae9d]">Adaptive Curriculum Navigation</span>
                  </div>
                  <h3 class="font-serif-editorial text-2xl font-bold text-white mt-1">Select Your Personalized Learning Pathway</h3>
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button onclick="resumePathway()" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#edae9d] hover:bg-[#e29b88] text-[#172126] font-bold text-xs transition flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg">
                    <i data-lucide="play" class="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current"></i>
                    <span>Resume Active Pathway</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- Pathway Toggle Pills -->
              <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-2.5">
                ${Object.values(coursePathways).map(p => {
                  const isSel = state.selectedPathway === p.id;
                  return `
                    <button onclick="setPathway('${p.id}')" class="p-3.5 rounded-2xl text-left border transition flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 ${isSel ? 'bg-[#3e6892] border-[#edae9d] text-white ring-2 ring-[#edae9d]/40 shadow-lg' : 'bg-stone-800/80 hover:bg-stone-800 border-stone-700 text-stone-300 hover:text-white'}">
                      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <i data-lucide="${p.icon}" class="w-4 h-4 ${isSel ? 'text-[#edae9d]' : 'text-stone-400'}"></i>
                        <span class="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded ${isSel ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-stone-700 text-stone-300'}">${p.estHours}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div class="font-serif-editorial font-bold text-xs leading-snug ${isSel ? 'text-white' : 'text-stone-200'}">${p.title}</div>
                        <div class="text-[10px] ${isSel ? 'text-stone-200' : 'text-stone-400'} mt-0.5">${p.badge}</div>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  `;
                }).join('')}
              </div>

              <!-- Active Pathway Focus & Progress Summary -->
              ${(function() {
                const active = coursePathways[state.selectedPathway] || coursePathways.all;
                const pathModules = active.modules;
                const totalPathLessons = pathModules.reduce((acc, mNum) => {
                  const m = courseData[mNum - 1];
                  return acc + (m ? m.lessons.length : 0);
                }, 0);
                const completedPathLessons = pathModules.reduce((acc, mNum) => {
                  const m = courseData[mNum - 1];
                  if (!m) return acc;
                  return acc + m.lessons.filter(l => state.completedLessons.has(l.id)).length;
                }, 0);
                const pathPct = Math.round((completedPathLessons / Math.max(totalPathLessons, 1)) * 100);

                return `
                  <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-stone-900/90 border border-stone-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs">
                    <div class="max-w-xl space-y-1">
                      <div class="font-bold text-[#bbd4c5] text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span>Current Focus: ${active.title}</span>
                        <span class="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-stone-800 text-stone-300 border border-stone-700">${pathModules.length} Core Modules Included</span>
                      </div>
                      <p class="text-stone-300 leading-relaxed text-[11px]">${active.desc}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="w-full sm:w-48 space-y-1.5 shrink-0">
                      <div class="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-mono">
                        <span class="text-stone-400">Pathway Progress</span>
                        <span class="font-bold text-[#edae9d]">${pathPct}% (${completedPathLessons}/${totalPathLessons})</span>
                      </div>
                      <div class="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-stone-800 overflow-hidden border border-stone-700">
                        <div class="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#3e6892] via-[#bbd4c5] to-[#edae9d] rounded-full transition-all duration-500" style="width: ${pathPct}%"></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                `;
              })()}
            </div>

            <!-- 8 Curriculum Modules with Realistic Photographic Editorial Covers -->
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              ${courseData.map((m, idx) => {
                const modNum = idx + 1;
                const activePathway = coursePathways[state.selectedPathway] || coursePathways.all;
                const isCore = activePathway.modules.includes(modNum);
                const totalL = m.lessons.length;
                const doneL = m.lessons.filter(l => state.completedLessons.has(l.id)).length;
                const isModDone = doneL === totalL && totalL > 0;
                const photoSrc = coursePhotos['mod' + modNum] || coursePhotos.hero;

                return `
                  <div onclick="navigateTo('lesson', ${idx}, 0)" class="module-photo-card rounded-3xl overflow-hidden cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between group ${isCore ? 'ring-2 ring-[#EDAE9D]/30 border-[#EDAE9D]/40' : 'opacity-85 hover:opacity-100'}">
                    
                    <!-- 16:9 Realistic Photograph Cover -->
                    <div class="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden bg-stone-900">
                      <img src="${photoSrc}" alt="Module ${m.num} Cover" class="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500">
                      <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#10161E] via-[#10161E]/40 to-transparent"></div>
                      
                      <!-- Top Badges on Image -->
                      <div class="absolute top-2.5 left-2.5 right-2.5 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-white border border-white/10">
                          MOD ${m.num}
                        </span>
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold font-mono tracking-wider backdrop-blur-md ${isCore ? 'bg-[#EDAE9D] text-[#080C10] shadow-sm' : 'bg-black/60 text-stone-300 border border-white/10'}">
                          ${isCore ? '★ Core Required' : 'Elective'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Card Body -->
                    <div class="p-4 sm:p-5 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3">
                      <div>
                        <h4 class="font-serif-editorial font-bold text-base sm:text-lg text-white group-hover:text-[#EDAE9D] transition-colors leading-snug">${m.title}</h4>
                      </div>

                      <div class="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10 text-xs">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-stone-400 font-mono text-[10px]">
                          <span>${doneL} of ${totalL} Lessons</span>
                          <span class="text-[#EDAE9D]">${isModDone ? '✓ Completed' : ''}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full bg-stone-800 overflow-hidden">
                          <div class="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#3E6892] via-[#BBD4C5] to-[#EDAE9D] rounded-full transition-all" style="width: ${Math.round((doneL / Math.max(totalL, 1)) * 100)}%"></div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#EDAE9D] group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-transform">
                          <span>Enter Masterclass</span>
                          <i data-lucide="chevron-right" class="w-3.5 h-3.5"></i>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                `;
              }).join('')}
            </div></div>
          </div>

        </div>
      `;
    }
